C0870.title: China's First Bitcoin Ransomware Case Cracked
C0870.summary: Nantong police cracked China first Bitcoin ransomware case, arresting three suspects: Ju, Xie, and Tan. The case involved more than 400 victim enterprises nationwide, with Ju committing more than 100 attacks. Attackers used ransomware to encrypt files and demand Bitcoin ransom, illegally profiting over 5 million yuan. The case revealed a complete black-market chain of ransomware development, deployment, and ransom monetization.
